261: He becomes sure that no one short of God is able to do anything;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
O Nanak, this whole creation has appeared from God alone. ॥51॥
ਲੇਖੈ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
We err at every moment; if an account were taken, we could in no way be cleared.
ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, pray: O forgiving Lord, forgive us Yourself and carry us across. ॥1॥
ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ; ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ॥
Man is ungrateful, a sinner, shallow of mind, and remains a stranger to God;
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ; ਤਾਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਤਤ ॥
he does not recognise the Source who gave him soul and body.
ਲਾਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
To earn Maya he goes searching in all ten directions,
ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
but the giving God, able to give everything, he does not keep in his mind even for an instant.
ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ; ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Greed, falsehood, vice and attachment: this is the wealth he hoards in his mind.
ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਹਾ; ਤਿਨਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
His life passes in the company of the lustful, thieves and great slanderers.
ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਖੋਟੇ. ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
If it pleases You, You forgive the false by keeping them in the company of the genuine.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਪਾਹਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme God, He saves even the stone-hearted from drowning by the gift of the Name. ॥52॥
ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ; ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Eating, drinking, playing and laughing in Maya's pleasures, we have wandered through many births.
ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ. ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, pray: Lord, pull us out of the world-ocean; You alone are our support. ॥1॥
ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਆਇਓ; ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
Amusing himself in Maya's colours, man comes through countless births, suffering.
ਖੇਦ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਤ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
If he meets the Guru and his mind merges in the Guru's words, all troubles are wiped out.
ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ. ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਓ; ਖਾਇਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
One who has taken up forgiveness, gathered the wealth of the Name and made the nectar of the Name his food,
ਖਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਈ; ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
on him the Master's great grace falls, and he rests in spiritual joy and peace.
ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ; ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
One who has carried this trade through to the end has earned the profit; he becomes steady in mind and wins honour.
ਖਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ. ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
The Guru gave him firm reassurance, and he was joined to the Lord's feet.
ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ. ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
O Lord, You made all this play and You do everything now; here and hereafter You Yourself are the protector.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ; ਜਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੫੩॥
O Nanak, praise always Him alone who is present in every body. ॥53॥
ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
O God, treasure of grace, merciful One, we have come to Your refuge.
ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਬਸਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those in whose mind the one imperishable Lord dwells stay ever in bloom. ॥1॥
God created the three worlds within His command.
By His command the Vedas were composed and studied.
All the Shastras, Simritis and Puranas are expressions of His command.
Their singing, telling and exposition are also displays of His command.
Finding release from the world's fears and doubts is also a light of His command.
Recognising the deeds worth doing and seeking the rules of inner purity are also a showing of His command.
All this visible world is the manifest form of His command,
yet, O Nanak, the Supreme God Himself is beyond its influence. ॥54॥
The unreachable Lord holds the pen in His hand and goes on writing on the foreheads of all.
ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ; ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
That Lord of matchless beauty is interwoven with all beings.
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
O Lord, my mouth cannot tell Your greatness.
O Nanak, say: seeing Your sight my soul is entranced and gives itself up to You. ॥1॥
ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ. ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਘਨਾਸ ॥
O unshakeable Supreme God, imperishable, destroyer of sins,
ਹੇ ਪੂਰਨ. ਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
O perfect One present in all beings, remover of suffering, treasure of virtues,
ਹੇ ਸੰਗੀ. ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ; ਹੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਟੇਕ ॥
O companion of all and yet without form, untouched by Maya, support of all,
ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ. ਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
O carer of creation, treasure of virtues, in whom the power to discern is ever present,
ਹੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਹਹਿ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
O Lord beyond the beyond, You are now and You remain for ever.
ਹੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
O constant helper of the saints, support of those who have no support,
ਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ; ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ. ਗੁਨੁ, ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
O Sustainer, I am Your small servant; I am without merit, there is no virtue in me.
262: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ; ਰਾਖਉ ਹੀਐ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੫੫॥
Grant Nanak the gift of the Name, to keep strung within the heart. ॥55॥
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ. ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
The Guru is mother, the Guru is father; the Guru is the Master, the Transcendent Lord.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ. ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the friend who dispels ignorance; the Guru is kin and brother.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the giver who teaches the Lord's Name; the Guru's teaching never fails.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the embodiment of peace, truth and wisdom; the Guru's touch surpasses the philosopher's stone.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the place of pilgrimage, the pool of amrit; bathing in the Guru's wisdom is beyond compare.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਪਤਿਤ, ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the Creator's form, remover of all sins; the Guru makes the fallen pure.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
The Guru has been, from the beginning, through every age; chanting the Lord's mantra the Guru gives, we are carried across.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
O Lord, be kind and join us to the Guru's company, that we fools and sinners may hold on and be saved.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
The Guru is the True Guru, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows to the Guru, the form of Hari. ॥1॥
This salok is read at the beginning and at the end
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
I bow to the Primal Guru;
I bow to the Guru from the start of the ages;
I bow to the True Guru;
I bow to the great, divine Guru. ॥1॥
Let me remember the Lord, and remembering, remembering, find peace,
and wipe out the anguish and strife within the body.
Let me remember the praise of the One who sustains the world,
The Vedas, Puranas and Smritis, the purest of words,
were made from the one Name of the Lord.
One in whose heart even a particle of it dwells —
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਗਨੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Those who long only for a glimpse of You —
Sukhmani: the jewel of peace is the Lord's amrit Name;
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
it rests in the minds of the devotees. Rahao
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
Remembering the Lord, one does not enter the womb again;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
remembering the Lord, pain and the fear of death flee;
remembering the Lord, death is pushed away;
remembering the Lord, the enemy retreats;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
remembering the Lord, no obstacle stands in the way;
remembering the Lord, one stays awake night and day;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
remembering the Lord, fear takes no hold;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
remembering the Lord, sorrow does not torment.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Remembrance of the Lord is found in the company of the holy;
Nanak: all treasures lie in the Lord's love. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
In remembering the Lord are all powers, miracles and the nine treasures;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
in remembering the Lord are wisdom, meditation and understanding of the essence;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
in remembering the Lord are all chanting, austerity and worship;
remembering the Lord, the sense of "other" vanishes;
remembering the Lord is bathing at the true place of pilgrimage;
remembering the Lord brings honour in the divine court;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
remembering the Lord, whatever happens seems good;
remembering the Lord, life bears its fruit.
They alone remember whom the Lord inspires to remember;
263: O Nanak, let me fall at the feet of those who remember Him. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Remembering God is better than every other effort;
by remembering God many are saved from vice.
By remembering God the thirst for Maya is quenched,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
for every play of Maya comes to be understood.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
By remembering God the fear of death's messengers ends,
and the mind is satisfied in its hopes.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
By remembering God the mind's filth of vice goes,
and the immortalising Name settles in the heart.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ; ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
God dwells on the tongues of those who follow the Guru.
O Nanak, let me be the servant of their servants. ॥4॥
Those who remember God are the wealthy,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
Those who remember God are accepted and acclaimed,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
and they are the best of all people.
Those who remember God are dependent on no one;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
they are rather the kings of all.
Those who remember God live in peace,
and are for ever free of birth and death.
ਸਿਮਰਨ. ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
But only those to whom God Himself is kind take to His remembrance;
O Nanak, a fortunate one asks for the dust of their feet. ॥5॥
Those who remember God become doers of good to others;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
I give myself up to them for ever.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
Those who remember God have beautiful faces,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
and their life passes in peace.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Those who remember God conquer their own self,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
and their way of living becomes pure.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Those who remember God have joys upon joys,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
for they live in God's presence.
Only by the saints' grace does this constant wakefulness of remembrance come;
O Nanak, remembrance is received by great good fortune. ॥6॥
By remembering God all of a person's tasks are completed,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
and he never falls prey to worry.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
By remembering God he utters only the Lord's virtues,
and stays settled in the state of poise.
By remembering God the seat of his mind does not waver,
and the lotus of his heart stays in bloom.
By remembering God an unbroken music goes on within;
ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
the peace that comes of remembering God never ends.
ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ; ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
Only those remember Him on whom God's kindness rests;
O Nanak, a fortunate one takes the refuge of such people. ॥7॥
By remembering the Lord the devotees become renowned;
absorbed in remembrance, the sages composed the Vedas.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Through remembering the Lord men became Siddhas, celibates and givers;
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
by its blessing the lowly became known across the whole world.
Remembrance of the Lord holds up the whole earth;
so remember always the Lord, the Maker of the world.
The Lord made the whole creation for the sake of remembrance;
where there is remembrance, the Formless One Himself dwells.
One to whom He in His mercy gives this understanding,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
O Nanak, he receives the gift of remembrance through the Guru. ॥8॥1॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
O destroyer of the pain and suffering of the poor, present in every body, Master of the masterless,
ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
O God, holding on to Guru Nanak I have come to Your refuge. ॥1॥
264: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ; ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Where neither mother, father, son, friend nor brother stands by you,
ਮਨ ਊਹਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
there, O mind, the Name is with you as your helper.
ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ; ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
Where there is the host of death's most dreadful messengers,
ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
there only the Name goes with you.
Where the difficulty is very great,
ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ; ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
the Lord's Name saves in the blink of an eye.
Even by performing countless religious rites one is not saved from sins,
ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
but the Lord's Name destroys millions of sins.
So, O my mind, take the Guru's refuge and repeat the Name;
O Nanak, you will find great happiness. ॥1॥
Even as king of the whole world a man stays unhappy,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
but by repeating the Lord's Name he becomes happy.
Earning hundreds of thousands and millions puts no check on the thirst for Maya;
by repeating the Lord's Name a man crosses that flood.
ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ; ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
With all Maya's countless pleasures the thirst is not quenched,
but by repeating the Lord's Name one is satisfied.
On the paths where this soul goes alone,
ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ; ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
there the Lord's Name is with it, giving comfort.
Such a Name, O mind, we should always remember;
O Nanak, through the Guru the highest state is reached. ॥2॥
Where millions of brothers at his side cannot free a man,
from there those who repeat the Name cross over.
Where countless obstacles come and crush him,
the Lord's Name rescues at once.
The soul is born in countless forms, dies and is born again;
by repeating the Name it comes to rest.
ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Soiled by pride, the soul never washes off this filth,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
but the Lord's Name destroys millions of sins.
Repeat such a Name with love, O mind;
O Nanak, it is found in the company of those who follow the Guru. ॥3॥
ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ; ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ. ਕੋਸਾ ॥
On the journey whose miles cannot be counted,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
the Lord's Name is the provision that goes with the soul.
On the road where there is pitch darkness,
the Lord's Name is the light alongside.
ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ; ਤੇਰਾ. ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
On the path where you have no true confidant,
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
there the Lord's Name is the true companion with you.
ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ; ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
Where there is dreadful burning and great heat,
ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
there the Lord's Name is the shade over you.
Where the thirst for Maya keeps pulling at you,
ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
there, O Nanak, the Lord's Name rains down. ॥4॥
The Name is what the devotees keep in constant use;
it stays settled in the minds of the saints.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
The Lord's Name is the support of His servants;
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ; ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
through the Lord's Name millions are saved from vice.
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ; ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
The saints praise the Lord day and night,
and gather the medicine of the Lord's Name.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
For the Lord's servants His Name is the treasure;
the Supreme God Himself has given them this gift.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ; ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
In mind and body they stay dyed in the love of the One;
O Nanak, in them grows a nature that discerns good from bad. ॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
For the devotee the Lord's Name is the means of release from Maya's bonds;
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
through the Lord's Name he is sated with Maya's pleasures.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
The Lord's Name is the devotee's beauty and grace;
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਕਬ. ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
repeating the Lord's Name, he never meets any hindrance.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
The Lord's Name is the devotee's honour;
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ; ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
through the Lord's Name the devotees have won renown.
265: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
For the devotee, the Lord's Name is both the ascetic's yoga and the householder's enjoyment of Maya,
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
and while he repeats the Lord's Name no pain or distress touches him.
ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
The devotee stays absorbed in the service of the Lord's Name, which is remembrance;
O Nanak, he always worships the divine Lord. ॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
For the devotee the Lord's Name is his wealth and property,
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
and God Himself has given this wealth of the Name to His devotee.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
For the devotee the Lord's Name is a strong support,
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ; ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
and by the Lord's glory the devotees look to no other support.
ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ; ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
The devotees stay soaked through and through in the savour of the Lord's Name,
and, drunk on that savour, they enjoy the stillness of mind in which no thought stirs.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
All eight watches of the day the devotee repeats the Lord's Name;
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ; ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
the Lord's devotee becomes known in the world and does not stay hidden.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
Devotion to the Lord frees countless beings from vice;
O Nanak, in the devotee's company many others cross over too. ॥7॥
This Name of the Lord is itself the Parjat tree,
and singing the Lord's virtues is Kamdhen, the cow that fulfils wishes.
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
Talk of the Lord's praise is better than all other talk,
for on hearing the Name all pain and sorrow fall away.
ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
The greatness of the Name lives in the hearts of the saints,
and by the saints' glory all sin is driven off.
The company of the saints is found by great good fortune,
and by serving the saints one comes to remember the Name.
ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ; ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Nothing else is equal to the Lord's Name;
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
O Nanak, only a rare person, turning to the Guru, finds the gift of the Name. ॥8॥2॥
ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ. ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ; ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
Many Shastras and many Simritis, I have searched through them all and seen:
ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
they cannot match the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, no price can be set on the Name. ॥1॥
Someone may recite mantras, practise austerities, talk much of knowledge and fix his mind on the gods,
expound the six Shastras and the Simritis,
practise the disciplines of yoga and perform the rites of ritual religion,
or give up all work and wander in the forests;
he may make great efforts of many kinds,
give in charity and pour much ghee into the sacred fire,
have his body cut up bit by bit and burn it in the fire,
and bind himself to fasts of many kinds;
yet none of these equals reflection on the Lord's Name,
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, even if the Name is repeated only once, turned to the Guru. ॥1॥
ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ; ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Someone may roam the whole earth and live to a great age,
turn right away from the world and become a great ascetic,
offer up his own life in the fire,
give away gold, horses, fine steeds and land,
practise the niuli cleansing and many yoga postures,
follow the way of the Jains with its very hard disciplines and restraints,
and have his body cut up bit by bit;
ਤਉ ਭੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
even then the filth of pride does not leave the mind.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ; ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
No such effort is equal to the Lord's Name;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, those who repeat the Name, turned to the Guru, reach the high spiritual state. ॥2॥
Some set their heart on giving up the body at a place of pilgrimage,
ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ; ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
but even so pride and arrogance do not lessen in the mind.
A person may bathe at holy places day and night,
ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ; ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
yet the mind's filth is not removed by washing the body.
ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ; ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
He may put this body through many disciplines,
ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ; ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
yet Maya's hold never shifts from the mind.
He may wash this perishable body with water many times,
yet how can this wall of unbaked clay ever become pure?
ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
O my mind, the greatness of the Lord's Name is very high;
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ; ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, by the Name countless wrongdoers are saved from vice. ॥3॥
ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Because of his great cleverness the fear of death's messengers bears down on a person,
266: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
for however many clever efforts he makes, the thirst for Maya does not end.
Putting on many religious garbs does not put out the fire of craving,
and millions of such methods do not clear one in the Lord's court.
He cannot escape Maya, whether he climbs to the sky or hides in the netherworld;
rather, beings are caught in Maya's net and in attachment.
Every deed other than the Name is penalised by the lord of death,
ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
who is not satisfied in the least without devotion to God.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
The one who utters the Lord's Name has his suffering removed,
O Nanak, when he utters it with love, settled in inner poise. ॥4॥
If anyone is in need of the four great boons of life,
he should take up the service of those who are turned to the Guru.
If anyone wishes to end his own suffering,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
he should always remember the Lord's Name in his heart.
If anyone wants a good name for himself,
he should stay in the company of the holy and give up this pride.
ਜੇ ਕੋ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
If anyone fears the round of birth and death,
he should fall at the feet of the saints.
ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
The one who longs for the sight of God,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, to him I am always a sacrifice. ॥5॥
That person is the greatest among all people
whose arrogance is wiped away in the company of the holy.
The one who thinks himself worse than everyone else
should be counted better than all.
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ; ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
The one whose mind is the dust of everyone's feet
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
has recognised the Lord's power in every body.
The one who has wiped evil from his own mind
sees all the creatures of the world as his friends.
Such people look on pleasure and pain alike,
and so, O Nanak, sin and merit leave no mark on them. ॥6॥
For the poor, Your Name is wealth;
the one with no support has Your support.
For the one without honour, O God, Your Name is honour;
You give gifts to all beings.
O Master, You Yourself do everything and have it done,
O knower of every creature's heart!
You alone know Your own state and the measure of Your greatness;
You are absorbed in Yourself, O God.
Your greatness can be told by You alone;
O Nanak, no one else knows it. ॥7॥
Of all religions this is the best religion:
ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
repeat the Lord's Name and make your conduct pure.
Of all religious rites this is the highest:
to stay in the company of the holy and remove the filth of evil thinking.
Of all efforts this is the best effort:
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
O my mind, always repeat the Lord's Name.
Of all speech the most beautiful is the life-giving word of the Lord's praise:
ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ; ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
hear the Lord's praise and speak it with your tongue.
ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ; ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Holier than all places of pilgrimage is that place,
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ; ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
O Nanak, the heart in which the Lord's Name lives. ॥8॥3॥
ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O ignorant one without virtue, always remember that Master.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ. ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Keep in your mind the One who made you; O Nanak, He alone will stand by you to the end. ॥1॥
O living being, remember the virtues of the beautiful Lord;
see from what beginning He has shown you forth, and how fair.
He who made you, shaped you and adorned you,
who kept you safe even in the fire of the womb,
who gives you milk to drink in infancy,
and in the fullness of youth gives food and the sense of comforts,
who, when you grow old, has relatives and friends ready to serve you
267: and put good food in your mouth as you sit: remember that Lord.
ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ; ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
But this being without virtue understands none of Your kindness;
O Nanak, only if You Yourself show grace can he succeed in the purpose of his life. ॥1॥
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
He by whose grace you live in comfort on the earth
ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ; ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
and laugh with your sons, brothers, friends and wife;
by whose grace you drink cool water
and have the soothing wind and priceless fire;
by whose grace you enjoy every pleasure
and have all things at hand for your use;
ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ; ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
who gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue:
forgetting Him, you are absorbed in others.
These blind fools are caught in faults such as this;
O Nanak, pray for them: O God, pull them out Yourself. ॥2॥
He who protects a person from birth to the hour of death,
ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਕਰੈ; ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
that Lord the fool does not love.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
He by serving whom one gains all nine treasures,
ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ; ਮਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
to that Lord the foolish being does not join his mind.
The Master who is at his side at every moment
the blind man takes to be somewhere far away.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
He by whose service one gains respect in the Lord's court,
that Lord the ignorant fool forgets.
This being goes on making mistakes for ever;
O Nanak, the Lord who protects is boundless. ॥3॥
Leaving the jewel of the Name, he goes about pleased with the cowrie shell of Maya.
Leaving the true Lord, he puffs himself up over perishable things.
ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ; ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
What he must leave behind he takes to be permanent,
and death, which is certain to come, he imagines to be far off.
ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
He toils day after day for what he must leave in the end,
and has forgotten the Lord who is with him as his protector.
A donkey washes off a coating of sandalwood paste,
for a donkey's love is always for ashes.
Through love of Maya beings lie fallen in a dark and dreadful well;
O Nanak, pray: O merciful God, pull them out. ॥4॥
He is human by birth, but his deeds are those of a beast,
and day and night he puts on a show for people.
Outwardly he wears religious dress, but in his mind is the filth of Maya;
however he tries to cover it, the mind's filth does not stay hidden.
Outwardly, for show, he bathes at holy places, talks of knowledge and sits in meditation,
but within, the dog of greed has him in its grip.
Within is the fire of craving; outwardly the body is smeared with ash.
With the stones of vice round his neck, how can he swim the bottomless ocean of the world?
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Those in whose hearts God Himself comes to live,
O Nanak, they alone stay settled in unshaken poise. ॥5॥
How can a blind man find the way merely by hearing of it?
O Lord, take his hand Yourself, so that he may keep his love to the end.
What can a deaf man make of a mere sign?
Signal to him that it is night, and he takes it to be day.
How can a mute sing Bishanpadas, the songs of praise?
ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ; ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
However he tries, his tune stays broken.
How can a cripple roam over the mountains?
ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ; ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
O Creator, ocean of mercy, this humble servant makes his plea;
O Nanak, only by Your grace can he cross over. ॥6॥
ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ. ਚੀਤਿ ॥
The Lord who is his companion and helper he does not call to mind,
yet he gives his love to the one who is his enemy.
He lives in a house of sand,
and still revels in pleasures, drunk on Maya.
He takes himself to be lasting, and his mind is sure of it;
the thought of death never enters the fool's mind.
falsehood, evil deeds, great greed and deceit:
268: on this path many of his lives have passed.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ; ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, pray for him: Lord, show Your own grace and save him. ॥7॥
You are the Master; it is before You that we make our plea.
This soul and body are all Your gift.
ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ; ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
You are our mother and father, we are Your children;
in Your grace lie countless comforts.
No one can find Your limit,
for You are God, higher than the highest.
All things in the world rest in Your command,
and the creation You have made moves by Your order.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
What You are like and how great You are, You alone know.
O Nanak, Your servants are always a sacrifice to You. ॥8॥4॥
ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ; ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
Leaving God the Giver, beings attach themselves to other tastes;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, no such person ever succeeds, for without the Name honour does not last. ॥1॥
A person takes ten things from God and stores them away,
but for the sake of one thing he loses his credit.
ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ; ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
If God did not give even that one, and took back the ten as well,
then tell me, what could this fool do?
The Master against whom nothing avails,
before Him one should always bow the head,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
for the one to whose mind God is dear
has every comfort come to live in his heart.
The one whom God brings to accept His command,
O Nanak, has as good as found all the things of the world. ॥1॥
God the banker gives the trader a stock of countless goods,
and he eats, drinks and uses them with pleasure and delight.
ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ; ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
If the banker takes back some part of what He entrusted,
this ignorant one feels aggrieved in his mind;
in this way he himself destroys his own credit,
ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਉਸ ਕਾ; ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
and he is not trusted again.
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
If he lays the thing before the One it belongs to,
and accepts God's command with bowed head,
then God makes him four times as happy as before.
O Nanak, the Master is always merciful. ॥2॥
The attachments of Maya are of many kinds,
but know that all of them pass away in the end.
ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
If someone falls in love with the shade of a tree,
the shade passes, and he grieves in his mind.
All this world that is seen is passing,
yet this blindest of the blind clings to it.
Whoever gives his love to a passing traveller
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
ends with nothing in his hands.
ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
O my mind, love of the Lord's Name is what gives comfort;
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, it comes to the one whom God, in His grace, Himself attaches to it. ॥3॥
When the body, wealth and all the family are perishable,
then ownership of Maya and pride, and the conceit resting on them, are false too.
Kingship, youth, wealth and property are all perishable,
so the lust and dreadful anger they give rise to are futile too.
Chariots, elephants, horses and clothes do not last,
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
and the laughter of one who gazes fondly on all this Maya is futile.
Deceit, attachment and arrogance are futile,
and being proud of oneself is false as well.
What lasts is devotion to God, practised in the Guru's refuge.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
O Nanak, a person truly lives by dwelling always on the feet of the Lord. ॥4॥
Futile are the ears that listen to slander of others;
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ; ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
futile the hands that steal others' wealth;
269: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ; ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
futile the eyes that gaze on the beauty of another's wife;
futile the tongue given over to food and other tastes;
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ; ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
futile the feet that run to do others harm.
O my mind, you too are futile if you covet others' wealth.
Futile are the bodies that do no good to others;
futile the nose that takes in the scent of vice.
Without understanding their purpose, all these limbs are futile.
ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, fruitful is the body that repeats the Lord's Name. ॥5॥
The life of one cut off from God goes to waste,
for without the true Lord how can he be pure?
Without the Name the body of that blind man is of no use,
for the stench of slander and the like comes from his mouth.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
Without remembrance his days and nights pass in vain,
as a crop is lost without rain.
ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
Without devotion to God all a person's works are worth nothing,
as a miser's money is of no use to the miser himself.
ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ. ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Blessed are those in whose hearts the Lord's Name lives;
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to them. ॥6॥
The outward marks of religion he wears are one thing, and the life he lives another;
ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
there is no love for God in his mind, and he makes up for it with talk.
But God, who knows the heart, is wise;
He has never been pleased by anyone's outward garb.
The one who preaches to others but does not practise it himself
stays for ever in the round of birth and death.
The one in whose heart the Formless Lord lives,
by his teaching the world is saved from vice.
ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ; ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Those who are dear to You, O God, have come to know You;
O Nanak, I fall at their feet. ॥7॥
Whatever plea I make, God knows it all;
He Himself gives honour to the being He has made.
God Himself, and no other, makes the judgement:
ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ; ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
to one He makes it seem that God is far away, to another He gives the understanding that He is near.
He is beyond all devices and cleverness,
ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
for He knows everything about the inner life of the soul.
ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Whoever pleases Him He fastens to the hem of His robe;
God is present in every place.
He alone becomes a true servant to whom God shows grace.
O Nanak, remember such a Lord with every breath. ॥8॥5॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
May my lust, anger, greed, attachment and arrogance be taken away;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, pray: O Guru, O God, I have come to Your refuge, show me grace. ॥1॥
He by whose grace you eat many kinds of delicious food,
ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ; ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
keep that Master in your mind.
He by whose grace you put fragrances on your body,
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
by remembering Him you will reach the highest state.
He by whose grace you live in mansions of comfort,
remember Him always within your mind.
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
He by whose grace you live happily in your home,
remember Him with your tongue through all eight watches.
He by whose gift come amusements, tasty foods and good things,
O Nanak, He is worthy of meditation and should be meditated on always. ॥1॥
He by whose grace you wear silk clothes,
why forget Him and set your greed on something else?
He by whose grace you sleep in comfort on your bed,
ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
O my mind, His praise should be sung through all eight watches.
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
He by whose grace everyone honours you,
270: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ; ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
Speak His praise always with your mouth and tongue.
The Lord by whose grace your dharma stays firm,
O mind, always remember that supreme Lord.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
By worshipping God you will find honour in His court,
and, O Nanak, you will go from here to your own home with your honour intact. ॥2॥
The Lord by whose grace you have a healthy body like gold,
fix your attention on that beloved Lord.
He by whose mercy your covering stays in place,
ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
O mind, find peace by speaking the praise of that Lord.
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
He by whose kindness all your faults stay covered,
ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
O mind, take the shelter of that Lord, the Master.
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੁਝੁ. ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
He by whose grace no one can equal you,
ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ; ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
O mind, remember that high Lord with every breath.
He by whose grace you found this human body, so hard to come by,
O Nanak, give your devotion to that Lord. ॥3॥
He by whose grace ornaments are worn,
ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
O mind, why be lazy in remembering Him?
He by whose mercy you ride horses and elephants,
ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
O mind, never forget that Lord.
He by whose kindness gardens, lands and wealth are yours,
keep that Lord threaded into your mind.
O mind, the One who fashioned you,
remember Him always, rising and sitting.
Remember that Lord who is one and without limit.
O Nanak, in this world and the next it is He who guards your honour. ॥4॥
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
He by whose grace you give much in charity and alms,
ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
O mind, keep Him in mind through all eight watches.
He by whose mercy you are able to carry out rites and customs,
ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
remember that Lord with every breath.
He by whose kindness your form is beautiful,
The Lord by whose grace you were given the good estate of humankind,
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
remember Him always, day and night.
Remember the Name of Him by whose mercy your honour stands in the world.
O Nanak, one who receives the Guru's blessing speaks His praise. ॥5॥
He by whose grace you hear sound with your ears,
by whose mercy you see wondrous sights;
by whose blessing you speak sweet words with your tongue,
by whose grace you live in comfort without effort;
by whose kindness your hands and other limbs do their work,
by whose mercy you succeed in every undertaking;
by whose gift you reach high standing,
and stay absorbed in ease and freedom from care;
ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
forgetting such a Lord, what else are you attaching yourself to?
O Nanak, take the Guru's blessing and become alert within your mind. ॥6॥
The Lord by whose grace you are renowned in the world,
ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
never let Him slip from your mind.
He by whose mercy greatness has been given to you,
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ; ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
O foolish mind, repeat that Lord's Name.
He by whose grace all your tasks are brought to completion,
O mind, know Him to be always at your side.
He by whose blessing you obtain truth,
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
O my mind, stay joined to Him.
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Repeat the Name of Him by whose kindness every being is able to reach Him.
O Nanak, the one given this gift repeats only the Lord's Name. ॥7॥
Only the one whom He Himself causes to repeat it repeats the Lord's Name,
ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
and only the one whom He moves to sing sings the Lord's virtues.
